body:
The son's rite, full form in the Tantrāloka, short form here. Samayin-course done: on day three, communal worship in the trident-lotus — retinue and door-gods outside, then rows east to southeast: Gaṇapati, teachers past and present, yoginīs, Speech-lady, field-lord. Command taken, the whole course laid from trident-root to white lotus: goddess Parā center with Bhairava, Aparā left, Parāparā right (and south/left tridents likewise); goddess-presiding makes all full; the whole wheel to the weapon-guardians worshipped undivided — presided, all worshipped. Jar, pitcher, maṇḍala, fire, self linked in five, then special worship swollen with nonduality's rasa. No stinting; no wealth, no great circle. Living animals offered (graced thereby, doubt not, for pity's sake). Fire fed ghee and sesame for the Lord, a second beast for fat, wheel fat-fed, maṇḍala re-honored; Lord entreated; self seen whole-six-courses-full; pupil set before. For the far-off (living-dead), picture him — or a grass-and-dung stand-in. Sprinkle and honor him, lay the whole course in his body. Then judge: enjoyer — purify auspicious only; liberation-wisher — both; seedless — even time-bonds (dying and utter fool too, by Lord's command, devotion-only sufficing). Everywhere latency-grasping distinguishes (mantras work by latency-fitness). Reflecting latency-difference, by chief-mantra-grasping purify own-body-gone whole course in Śiva-nonduality: toe to twelve-end, pupil's body-consciousness reached as your own, in bliss's lake, lordship's pith, all-power-full wheel-lord, consciousness-remainder circle, one-made with pupil-self, rest: Lord-undivided he becomes. Join enjoyers where they hunger; then picture a sudden pure-principle body for the conduct that remains — the initiation loosing every bond. Pupil honors teacher; fire-rite per pupil ("Parā-mantra, so-and-so's so-principle I cleanse" + svāhā, thrice a principle, vauṣaḍa full): Śiva-end purity, joining full-offerings (a second for the enjoyer's station, a third for pure creation). Gifts to the teacher seal it: son-initiation, washing past and future deeds, the present kept.

The passage moves in seven steps. (1) Extensive in Tantrāloka, condensed here; samayin-course done → third-day communal triśūlābja-maṇḍala rite (retinue/door-gods outside; row worship Gaṇapati→kṣetrapāla; command taken; whole course laid root-to-lotus; goddess Parā center with Bhairava, Aparā left, Parāparā right; presiding makes all full; whole wheel to weapon-guardians worshipped undivided). (2) Jar/pitcher/maṇḍala/fire/self five-base linking + nonduality-rasa special worship; unstingy rite-house; no great maṇḍala without wealth; living animals offered (graced, doubt not, compassion). (3) Fire: Lord ghee-sesame fed, second animal for fat, wheel fat-fed, maṇḍala re-honored; Lord entreated; self seen whole-six-courses-full; pupil set before. (4) Unseen initiation (living-dead): meditate him or kuśa-dung image; sprinkle/honor, lay whole course in body. (5) Consider: enjoyer — purify auspicious only; liberation-wisher — both; seedless — even time-bonds (dying and utter fool, Lord's command, devotion-only suffices). (6) Latency-grasping distinguishes (mantras work by latency-fitness); reflecting latency-difference, by chief-mantra-grasping purify own-body-gone whole course in Śiva-nonduality (toe to twelve-end, one-made with pupil-self, rest = Lord-undivided). (7) Join enjoyers where they hunger; picture sudden pure-principle body for remaining conduct = all-bond-releasing initiation; pupil worships teacher; fire-rite per pupil (Parā-mantra + svāhā ×3/principle + vauṣaḍa full) = Śiva-end purity + joining full-offerings (second for enjoyer's station, third for pure creation); gifts seal = putraka (washing past+future, present kept).
terms: putraka (son-initiation), triśūlābja (trident-lotus), pañcādhikaraṇa (five-based linking), parokṣa (unseen), vāsanā (latency), yojanikā (joining), vauṣaḍa (full-offering close).
function: The putraka (son's) initiation rubric: full rite-house, latency-matched purification, joining-offerings, seal.
local_context: A13 (yāga/dīkṣā) precedes; A14 teaches putraka; A15 (sadyaḥ) follows.
boundary: Tantrāloka fullness (external). L1 CONDENSED (full close pass queued).
